observation.visible_scene: Two lit white taper candles stand in clear glass holders (one nearer the camera, one behind it) on a light speckled tile floor against a pale wall with a baseboard. The flames cast a warm glow and a soft shadow on the wall. The scene is otherwise static scenery.
visible_changes: For the first ~0.5 s only the two flickering candles are visible; no hand or cup is in frame.
Around t=0.6 s a green object begins to appear at the top edge, and by t=0.67–0.8 s a hand holding a green plastic cup enters from the upper right.

From t≈0.87 s to t≈2.2 s the hand keeps the green cup positioned above and to the right of the back candle's flame, tilting its opening toward the flame and making small approach/retreat movements; a corresponding hand/cup shadow shifts on the wall.
Throughout this hovering the cup never contacts the candle and both flames stay lit and continue flickering.
From t≈2.4 s onward the cup and hand rise toward the top edge and leave the frame; by the last view only the two burning candles remain, as at the start.
Minor overall framing drift is present between early and late views, but the dominant motion is the hand/cup entering and exiting, not a clear camera pan.
outside_clip_unknowns: What the green cup contains (if anything) and the purpose of holding it near the flame.
Any earlier or later events outside this cropped window, including whether the candles are eventually extinguished.
uncertain_details: Whether the cup emits any air or liquid toward the flame is not visually supported; no stream or disturbance of the flame from the cup is clearly seen.
The exact cause of small background shifts (camera jitter vs. hand/arm motion) is not determinable from the tile lines alone.
